seo.title: page الجديدة | MoroccoTripMap
seo.description: Plan your stay in El Jadida: UNESCO Portuguese City, Portuguese Cistern, ramparts, Haouzia and Sidi Bouzid beaches, fishing port, mellah and Atlantic corniche. Portuguese heritage meets the Atlantic 100 km from Casablanca.
seo.og_description: UNESCO Portuguese City, magical cistern, ramparts, beaches and fishing port on Morocco’s Atlantic coast.

overview.title: page في الجديدة
overview.p1: El Jadida, formerly Mazagan, preserves one of the finest Portuguese citadels in North Africa, a UNESCO World Heritage Site. Its massive ramparts rise directly from the ocean, its bastions offer exceptional panoramas and its underground cistern creates a unique spectacle of light and reflections.
overview.p2: Beyond the walls: a lively fishing port, a long corniche, the beaches of Sidi Bouzid and Haouzia, the historic mellah and colourful markets. The city remains authentic and less crowded than major tourist hubs — ideal as a stop from Casablanca or a coastal base.
overview.p3: One to three days are enough to explore the Portuguese City, enjoy seafood and relax on the beaches. Extend to Oualidia for oysters if time allows.

places.title: What to see in El Jadida
places.subtitle: UNESCO citadel, cistern, ramparts, beaches and port.

cistern.title: Portuguese Cistern
cistern.desc: Underground vaulted hall with columns reflected in water — the city’s jewel.

walls.title: Ramparts & Bastions
walls.desc: Wall circuit facing the ocean, Angel and Holy Spirit bastions, period cannons.

church.title: Church of the Assumption
church.desc: Rare Manueline church still standing inside the citadel.

harbor.title: Fishing Port
harbor.desc: Blue boats, daily fish landing and quay activity.

beach.title: Beach & Corniche
beach.desc: Long stretch of sand and lively promenade at the foot of the ramparts.

haouzia.title: Haouzia Beach
haouzia.desc: Large dune-backed beach to the north, often quieter.

mellah.title: Mellah
mellah.desc: Former Jewish quarter inside the walls, lanes and traces of synagogues.

souks.title: Souks & Central Market
souks.desc: Spices, fresh fish and crafts in the commercial heart of the city.

itinerary.title: Suggested 2-day itinerary in El Jadida
itinerary.subtitle: Citadel and port first, then beaches and relaxation.

detailed_itinerary.day1_md: Arrival from Casablanca; visit the Portuguese Cistern in the best light.
detailed_itinerary.day1_ad: Full wall circuit, Church of the Assumption and ocean views.
detailed_itinerary.day1_ed: Walk at the fishing port and grilled fish dinner.
detailed_itinerary.day2_md: Stroll through the former Jewish quarter and citadel streets.
detailed_itinerary.day2_ad: Relax on the central beach or trip to Haouzia / Sidi Bouzid.
detailed_itinerary.day2_ed: Promenade on the corniche and mint tea facing the Atlantic.

eat.title: Where to eat in El Jadida
eat.subtitle: Grilled fish, seafood and tables by the water

port.title: Port restaurants
port.desc: Day’s catch grilled a few metres from the boats.

corniche.title: Corniche cafés
corniche.desc: Tea, juice and sea view for a relaxed break.

medina.title: Medina tables
medina.desc: Simple authentic Moroccan cuisine near the citadel.

resort.title: Resort restaurants
resort.desc: International cuisine and seafood in a polished setting.

market.title: Central market
market.desc: Buy fresh fish and have it cooked in the small stalls.

sidi.title: Beach tables
sidi.desc: Grills and drinks facing the waves.

transport.title: Getting around
transport.desc: Train or bus from Casablanca (about 1h30). Petits taxis in town; agree the price for beach trips.

bargain.title: Sun & wind
bargain.desc: The Atlantic breeze cools things down. Sunscreen, hat and a light jacket remain useful even in summer.

water.title: Cash & opening hours
water.desc: Carry dirhams for the cistern and small shops. Check cistern opening times (often closed on Tuesdays).

daytrips.title: Best day trips from El Jadida
daytrips.subtitle: Beaches, lagoon and coastal villages.

oualidia.title: Oualidia & oysters
oualidia.desc: Famous lagoon and oyster farms about 1 hour south.

azemmour.title: Azemmour
azemmour.desc: Small historic town and medina on the Oum Er-Rbia.

haouzia_trip.title: Haouzia Beach
haouzia_trip.desc: Large dune beach for a day of sand and sea.

casablanca.title: Casablanca
casablanca.desc: Return or departure via the big city (1h–1h30).

q2.question: هل هو مجاني؟
q2.answer: معظم المواقع الخارجية مجانية؛ الصهريج برسوم دخول صغيرة.

q3.question: أفضل وقت في اليوم؟
q3.answer: الصباح الباكر أو أواخر بعد الظهر للضوء وقلة الناس.

q4.question: مناسب للعائلات؟
q4.answer: نعم، مع احتياطات عادية على الأسوار والدرج.
